offering_description.value: Akebia sells prescription medicines for anemia and elevated blood phosphate in people with chronic kidney disease. It supplies oral medicines through drug distributors and dialysis providers in the United States and licenses commercialization in selected overseas markets.

primary_products.value: ferric citrate tablets for phosphate control and iron deficiency anemia; vadadustat tablets for anemia in adults on dialysis

customer_segment.value: B2B: Drug wholesalers, specialty pharmacies, dialysis organizations and pharmaceutical licensees

revenue_model.value: product sales: Prescription tablets for anemia and elevated blood phosphate; licensing or royalties: Commercial rights to kidney disease medicines in selected markets

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Develops medicines, sources finished tablets from contract manufacturers and supplies wholesalers and dialysis organizations

geography_served.value: global: United States, with licensed commercialization in Europe and Japan

specialization.value: related lines: Oral medicines for anemia and phosphate control in chronic kidney disease

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Pharmaceutical wholesalers and specialty drug distributors; direct sales: Commercial teams serving dialysis organizations; partners / resellers: Pharmaceutical licensees in selected overseas markets
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Prescription drug approvals, manufacturing and safety monitoring overseen by the FDA and overseas drug regulators
